_what: What a paste into a composer becomes (parts/chat/read-data/paste-policy.mjs). Text longer than `long_text_chars` becomes a named text file attachment instead of filling the field; a pasted image attaches only when the clipboard's markup carries no text of its own (a copied web page carries both, and its text is what was meant; `markup_skip` names the tags whose bodies are never words); everything else is a normal paste, so the editor's own undo keeps working. `file_name` and `words` are what the person sees; the attachment can be taken back with the undo the composer offers.

words.attached_text: A long paste ({count} characters) became the attachment {name}.
